# Workspace Instructions

- This is a static GitHub Pages application using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
- Do not introduce build tools, frameworks, server-side code, or package dependencies.
- Chart.js may be loaded only from a CDN.
- GitHub tokens must never be hardcoded, logged, or committed.
- The app starts with empty data (no seeded strategies or journals) and persists to localStorage. GitHub Gist storage is implemented with passphrase-based encryption (AES-GCM + PBKDF2).
